pageTitle: kurze.url – Short links for your association

home.heading: Short links for your association
home.body: Create short, memorable links and see how often they are used.

notFound.heading: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

auth.linkSent: If that address has an account, a link is on its way.

teams.name: Team name
teams.none: You are not a member of any team yet. Ask the person who invited you to add you to one.
teams.noneMaintainer: You are not a member of any team yet. As a maintainer you can create one.
teams.slugHint: Appears in this team's web address, e.g. sv-gruenwald. It cannot be changed later.
teams.slugInvalid: Use 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
teams.slugTaken: That URL name is already taken. Please choose another.

links.heading: Your links
links.noShortDomain: This instance has no working short domain yet, so these links will not redirect.
links.slugGenerated: Leave empty and one will be generated
links.redirect301Warning: Browsers cache a 301. Clicks stop being counted, and changing the destination later will not reach anyone who has already visited.
links.deleteQuestion: Delete this link? Anyone who already has the short URL will get a 404.
links.passwordExplainer: Visitors have to enter this password before the link takes them anywhere. Share it with the people who should get through.
links.passwordProtected: This link is protected by a password.
links.passwordRemoveQuestion: Remove the password? Anyone with the short URL will get straight through afterwards.
links.passwordDerivedFromContext: Too easy to guess from this link, its destination, or the Verein's name. Choose something unrelated to all three.
links.passwordTooCommon: That password is one of the most common ones. Pick another.
links.passwordRejected: That password cannot be used. Pick another.
links.qrExplainer: The code points at the short URL, so you can change where the link goes without reprinting anything. Scans are counted separately from ordinary clicks.
links.qrFormatSvg: SVG — scales to any size, best for print
links.qrFormatPng: PNG — a fixed-size image, best for screens
links.qrSizeHint: Applies to the PNG. The result is the largest whole size that fits, so it can come out slightly smaller.
links.qrPreviewAlt: Preview of this link's QR code
links.qrPreviewUnavailable: The preview could not be loaded.
links.qrLowContrast: These two colours are too close together. A camera will not read the code — pick a darker code colour or a lighter background.
links.qrInvalidColor: Give the colours as six hex digits, for example 003366.
links.qrSizeRequiresPng: A size only applies to the PNG. Switch the format to PNG, or leave the size out.
links.qrRejected: That combination cannot be used. Change the colours or the size.

domains.heading: Your domains
domains.empty: No domains yet. Your links use the shared domain.
domains.hostnameHint: A subdomain you control, for example links.verein.de
domains.failed: Another team verified this hostname first
domains.recordsHeadingFor: Create these two DNS records for {{hostname}}
domains.deleteQuestion: Delete {{hostname}}? Adding the hostname back later starts verification from scratch.
domains.deleteBlockedByLinks_one: This domain still has 1 link. Delete it first.
domains.deleteBlockedByLinks_other: This domain still has {{count}} links. Delete them first.

reason.token_missing: The TXT record is not visible yet. DNS changes can take a few hours.
reason.token_mismatch: A TXT record exists but its value does not match. Check for a typo.
reason.unreachable: The hostname does not reach us yet. This is expected until the instance maintainer has added it.

verifyError.conflict: Another team already verified this hostname while you were waiting. It cannot be used by your team.
verifyError.notFound: This domain no longer exists. Reload the page.
verifyError.rateLimited: Too many checks just now. Please wait a while before trying again.
verifyError.unknown: Could not check this domain right now. Please try again.

audit.heading: History
audit.intro: Every change anyone made to this team.
audit.emptyUnfiltered: Nothing has happened in this team yet.
audit.forbiddenTitle: This part of the team is for admins
audit.forbiddenBody: The history records who changed what, so it is kept to the people who administer the team. Ask an owner if you need access.

members.heading: Who has access
members.soleOwner: A team must always have at least one owner.
members.inviteEmailHint: They get an invitation, or join straight away if they already have an account.
members.inviteEmailInvalid: That does not look like an email address.
members.invitedAddedSilently: {{email}} is in the team now. They are not notified, and will see it the next time they sign in.
members.errorAlreadyMember: That person is already in this team.
members.errorTeamBurst: Too many invitations from this team just now. Please wait an hour and try again.
members.errorInstanceBudget: This instance has used up its invitations for the month. Ask the maintainer before inviting anyone else.
members.errorNotConfigured: Invitations are not set up on this instance. Ask the maintainer.
members.errorMailFailed: The invitation could not be sent. Please try again.
members.errorRaced: The member list changed while you were working. It has been reloaded.

stats.heading: Statistics
stats.visitorsNote: Counted per day — someone returning on three days counts three times.
stats.seriesTableCaption: The same figures as a table
stats.chartLabel: Clicks and visitors from {{from}} to {{to}}: {{clicks}} clicks, {{visitors}} visitors
stats.chartLabelWithBots: Clicks and visitors from {{from}} to {{to}}: {{clicks}} clicks, {{visitors}} visitors, of which {{humanClicks}} human clicks and {{humanVisitors}} human visitors
stats.disabledTitle: Click counting is off for this link
stats.disabledBody: Nothing is recorded while it is off, so this is not the same as a link nobody clicked.
stats.disabledElsewhere: Counting is off now, but statistics recorded before it was switched off are still here.
stats.disabledAction: Turn it on in the link settings
stats.countingOffBanner: Click counting is currently switched off for this link — these figures are historical.
stats.noClicksBody: There are no statistics for this link.
stats.noClicksElsewhere: This link has statistics outside the window you are looking at.

errors.rateLimited: Too many links created just now. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
